in_marathi.name: Vetri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vetri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vetri is derived from the Tamil language and means 'victory'. It is a unisex name and is popular among Hindus. Vetri is a powerful name that symbolizes strength, courage, and triumph over adversity. It is believed that those named Vetri are born to overcome challenges and emerge victorious.
